in_hebrew.name: Mignon
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Petite, dainty, dear one
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Mignon הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the French word 'mignon', which means 'delightful' or 'cute'. This name was popular in France during the Middle Ages and was often given to girls. It is a diminutive of the name Marie.
